subject: Linear A
core_goal: Use JANUS to move from structurally secure observations toward testable lexical and grammatical hypotheses for Linear A without confusing transliteration, analogy, or repetition with decipherment.

key_principle.name: BEHAVIORAL_SEMANTIC_ANCHOR
key_principle.definition: Prefer meanings forced by independently observable function, position, arithmetic, or cross-context behavior over meanings proposed primarily from phonetic resemblance.
key_principle.external_example: KU-RO is associated with totals in administrative texts because the associated quantity equals the sum of preceding entries; this is a behavioral/positional anchor rather than a semantic guess.
key_principle.claim_boundary: KU-RO='total' is an anchor for subsequent inference, not permission to translate unrelated Linear A words by analogy.

current_anchor_levels.reason: Repeatedly occurs in accounting contexts at totals; arithmetic relation provides an external constraint.
Context and accounting position support a shortfall interpretation; must remain separate from KU-RO by controlled contrast.

current_anchor_levels.working_meaning: gift / homage or related ritual term
current_anchor_levels.reason: Proposed from structural and contextual analysis; not fixed by an independent bilingual anchor.
Repeated variants support a morphological hypothesis but do not identify full lexical semantics.
Alternation patterns suggest a recurrent grammatical function; independent cross-corpus replication is still required.

decipherment_ladder.name: SIGN_IDENTITY
decipherment_ladder.requirement: Palaeographic sign identity, allograph grouping, corpus provenance

decipherment_ladder.name: PHONETIC_PRIOR
decipherment_ladder.requirement: Use Linear B overlap or other comparative evidence only as a prior, never as final proof

decipherment_ladder.name: MORPHOLOGICAL_ROLE
decipherment_ladder.requirement: Prefix/suffix/inflection hypothesis supported by repeated positional contrast

decipherment_ladder.name: FUNCTIONAL_SEMANTIC_ANCHOR
decipherment_ladder.requirement: Meaning constrained by external behavior such as arithmetic, commodity, inventory, or document role

decipherment_ladder.name: LEXICAL_FAMILY
decipherment_ladder.requirement: Root hypothesis explains multiple attestations and morphological variants without ad hoc segmentation

decipherment_ladder.name: DECIPHERMENT_CLAIM
decipherment_ladder.requirement: Independent reproduction, explicit negative controls, alternative language-family tests, and broad corpus coverage

primary_machine_tests.name: ANCHOR_BLIND_LEXICAL_TEST
primary_machine_tests.purpose: Check whether a proposed semantic anchor predicts document function without exposing the candidate meaning to the detector during model fitting.

primary_machine_tests.name: PARTITION_SURVIVAL
primary_machine_tests.purpose: Require the candidate operator or lexical role to survive geographic, document-type, and held-out corpus partitions.

primary_machine_tests.name: LINEAR_B_PRIOR_ABLATION
primary_machine_tests.purpose: Measure how much a result depends on inherited Linear B sign values.

primary_machine_tests.name: ARITHMETIC_ANCHOR_REPLAY
primary_machine_tests.purpose: Re-identify accounting anchors such as KU-RO and KI-RO from numeric relations only, then test whether the same functional method finds unseen anchors.
primary_machine_tests.negative_control: Randomly permuted numeric totals preserving token and field marginals

primary_machine_tests.name: FORMULA_VARIANT_GRAPH
primary_machine_tests.purpose: Model repeated libation-formula variants as a graph and infer stable grammatical roles from controlled variation rather than direct translation.

primary_machine_tests.name: LANGUAGE_FAMILY_COMPETITION
primary_machine_tests.purpose: Score competing language-family hypotheses using the same frozen evidence budget and held-out corpus.
primary_machine_tests.rule: No single family may win from phonetic resemblance alone.

connection_to_meta_registry.application: Blind Unicode character names, transliteration labels, and canonical JANUS vocabulary so the detector cannot manufacture an apparent semantic connection from its representation layer.
A decipherment hypothesis must survive independent regional/document partitions and a matched null.
Every lexical or grammatical hypothesis carries provenance, evidence class, verifier, replication obligation, negative control, and maximum admissible claim.
Freeze exact source inscription, corpus version, transliteration layer, and analysis code before scoring a decipherment hypothesis.
A semantic interpretation can be proposed only after passing explicit evidence gates; uncertainty remains a first-class outcome.

new_connection.name: BEHAVIORAL_ANCHOR_CAN_BREAK_THE_TRANSLATION_CIRCLE
new_connection.observation: Linear A gives a route to meaning that does not require starting from a proposed translation: accounting behavior can anchor a word, then morphology and distribution can be inferred around that anchor.
new_connection.why_it_matters: This directly matches JANUS's evidence-first architecture and gives us a concrete route toward decipherment rather than merely pattern collection.

forbidden_shortcuts: Linear B phonetic equivalence treated as semantic equivalence
single-inscription translation promoted from one context
visual similarity between signs treated as linguistic identity
Unicode character names used as semantic labels
language-family resemblance counted as independent evidence when it generated the hypothesis
AI-generated glosses accepted without corpus-level prediction
high in-sample fit promoted without held-out inscriptions

secure: Linear A corpus digitization is available through SigLA and other digital resources
KU-RO has a strong accounting-based total function
Linear A/Linear B sign overlap can provide provisional phonetic priors
structural and regional analysis is productive even without full decipherment
current_research_position.external_corpus: SigLA is an open-access database aiming at exhaustive coverage of Linear A inscriptions; its update log notes that all GORILA tablets are present and additional documents were added in 2026.
current_research_position.computational_review: A 2024 systematic review catalogs computational decipherment approaches, digital corpora, and major challenges for Linear A and related Aegean scripts.

next_gate.name: LINEAR_A_ANCHOR_BENCH
next_gate.goal: Start from KU-RO/KI-RO as behavioral anchors, discover candidate analogues without exposing meanings, and test them on held-out inscriptions.
next_gate.success_condition: At least one nontrivial new lexical or grammatical hypothesis predicts unseen Linear A structure better than matched nulls and survives representation-blind and partition-blind controls.
next_gate.strong_claim_condition: External replication by an independently implemented pipeline.
